frames.label: Within reach of a proposed service point
frames.description: Existing-network access within 45 minutes to a proposed service point.

frames.label: Five regions along the corridor
frames.description: Groot-Amsterdam, Flevoland, Zuidoost-Friesland, Noord-Friesland and Overig Groningen.

frames.label: The broader twelve-region study area
frames.description: The full study population from Groot-Amsterdam through Flevoland to the northern Netherlands.

recommended_first_display.title: Change in inequality in job accessibility
recommended_first_display.note: Negative values indicate more equal access. Compare frames using the same metric and axis scale. Do not label these as percentage reductions.

optional_alternative.title: Change in the share below a fixed job-access benchmark
optional_alternative.display_conversion: Multiply raw values by 100 to display percentage-point changes: -5.12, -1.07 and -0.50 percentage points.
optional_alternative.note: The benchmark is the primary population's baseline median, 145,056 reachable jobs, held fixed across scenarios and frames. It is an analytical threshold, not a policy minimum.

note: The Gini, Theil, Palma, concentration index and FGT measures decline in all three frames, with smaller changes in broader populations. Relative needs-gap incidence rises slightly in all three. It is not valid to place all eight raw changes on one common importance ranking.
